question: About 400,000 people worked on the Apollo programme. What does that number do to the idea that the landings were faked?
answer: It makes the secret almost impossible to keep. Every one of them would have had to stay silent for more than half a century, through rivalries, divorces and deathbed confessions. A 2016 model of real leaked secrets found that a plot needing that many people would have come out within about four years.
move: The more people a secret needs, the sooner it leaks.
ask: When a story needs thousands of people to keep quiet forever, how likely is it really?
